usage: Native supporting group operations. Group creation does not teamify a group. Pinned creation/property serializer captures remain separate unchanged evidence; this inventory is not a tenant recording or command-parity claim.

rules.create: 201 resource; required displayName/mailNickname/mailEnabled/securityEnabled; no implicit team or owner resolution; at most 20 initial relationships
rules.references: user directory IDs become selected-cloud /v1.0/users/{id} bindings; nil omits the reference property and explicit empty stays []
rules.properties: preserve omitted and explicit empty values; no read-snapshot resend
rules.list: one page with opaque next link; top default 100 and maximum 999; count/expand/filter/orderby/search/select/top; no skip; advanced-query header/count explicitly selected
rules.mutations: never replay or infer absence/ownership from failures; propagation and compensation belong to explicit compositions
